title: Data platforms and pipelines
summary: The data layer under ML and AI work: Spark, lakehouse and stores, feature stores, cleaning and linking messy records, Snowflake and Databricks, dbt.
intro: This module covers the data layer under ML and AI work. It starts with large-scale compute with Spark, the lakehouse, warehouse and operational stores that hold the data, and the feature store that serves the same values to training and inference. It then turns to the state of a customer's data: cleaning and linking messy records, working inside Snowflake and Databricks accounts you do not own, and building tested transformations with dbt.
